newsitem.title: UK: IRA bomb suspect gives birth in London.
newsitem.headline: IRA bomb suspect gives birth in London.

text.p: Pregnant IRA bomb suspect Roisin McAliskey on Monday gave birth to a baby girl while under heavy armed guard in a London hospital.

McAliskey, 25, had been held in London's high security Holloway prison since last year pending possible extradition to Germany for questioning about an Irish Republican Army mortar attack on a British army base at Osnabreuck.
McAliskey, daughter of former radical Northern Ireland politician Bernadette Devlin McAliskey, denies any part in the bombing in which buildings were damaged but no one was injured.
She was transferred from prison to hospital three days ago to await the birth. Campaigners for her release said McAliskey's mother was with her for the birth.

Despite protests from the Irish Republic and Roman Catholic politicians, Britain had in the past repeatedly refused previous bail requests and insisted that she must remain in prison until her extradition case was heard.
